contemporary: Divorce rates in the Muslim world have risen to match global rates over the last decade
takeaways: If divorce comes, carry it out with taqwa, respect and the rulings, not in anger.
Never use children, money or the house as weapons against a former spouse.
Do not ask a spouse to give up something lawful they enjoy without good reason.
Keep a spouse's secrets, and overlook their mistakes without rubbing them in.
Protect your family from the Fire by building a pious home and treating each other at your best.

69:3.en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality

69:4.en: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity

69:5.en: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]

69:6.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحࣲ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةࣲ‏
69:6.en: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

69:7.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏
69:7.en: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees

69:8.en: Then do you see of them any remains

69:9.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
69:9.en: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin

69:10.ar: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةً
69:10.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]

69:11.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
69:11.en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

69:12.ar: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱ‏
69:12.en: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it

69:13.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ‏
69:13.en: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

69:14.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ‏
69:14.en: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow

69:15.en: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur

69:16.en: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm

69:17.ar: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ‏
69:17.en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]

69:18.ar: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةࣱ‏
69:18.en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed

69:19.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
69:19.en: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record

69:20.en: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account

69:21.en: So he will be in a pleasant life

69:23.en: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near

69:24.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
69:24.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past

69:25.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
69:25.en: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

69:26.en: And had not known what is my account

69:27.en: I wish my death had been the decisive one

69:28.en: My wealth has not availed me

69:29.en: Gone from me is my authority

69:30.en: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him

69:32.ar: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةࣲ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعࣰ ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
69:32.en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him

69:33.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
69:33.en: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great

69:34.en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor

69:35.en: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

69:36.en: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds

69:37.en: None will eat it except the sinners

69:38.en: So I swear by what you see

69:39.en: And what you do not see

69:40.en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger

69:41.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
69:41.en: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe

69:42.ar: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
69:42.en: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember

69:43.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds

69:44.en: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings

69:45.en: We would have seized him by the right hand

69:46.en: Then We would have cut from him the aorta

69:47.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
69:47.en: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him

69:48.en: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous

69:49.en: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers

69:50.en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers

69:51.en: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty

69:52.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

7mnMg3zx_6o.speaker_note: Surah Summaries series; links the surah to the previous surahs he covered in the same cluster
7mnMg3zx_6o.title: Surat Al-Haqqah Summary
7mnMg3zx_6o.one_line: Al-Haqqah supplies the emotional element of dawah: stories and Judgment scenes that stir hope, fear and reverence, binding belief to behaviour.
7mnMg3zx_6o.summary: He frames the first surahs of this cluster as four things a person needs to call to Islam: knowledge, values, and here remembrance, the emotional and spiritual attachment without which faith turns cold and eventually fades, like a marriage without love. Al-Haqqah, the ultimate truth, opens with questions meant to make you wonder, then recounts Thamud's sudden blast, Ad's seven nights of wind leaving bodies like hollow palm trunks, Pharaoh, and the ark of Nuh, as reminders for a conscious ear. He explains that hope of mercy and fear of punishment are strong motives that make obeying easier. The Day itself: the heavens torn, eight bearing the Throne, every secret exposed. The one given his book in his right hand wants everyone to read it; the one given it in his left wishes he had never been accountable at all and finds his wealth and status useless. He dwells on the two reasons named for punishment: not believing in Allah and not urging the feeding of the poor. The Quran never punishes for belief alone, he argues, so separating creed from conduct makes religion harmful. The closing verse on what would happen if the Prophet fabricated even a word instils reverence, ending in certainty and glorification.

outline.heading: Opening
Four things needed for dawah
outline.gist: Knowledge, values and ethics, and remembrance: an emotional and spiritual connection, each covered by a surah of this cluster.

outline.heading: Knowledge and ethics without spirit go cold
outline.gist: Some people know a lot and behave well but feel nothing, and without attachment they eventually tire and drift away.

outline.heading: Remembrance and the name Al-Haqqah
outline.gist: The surah moves the reader through history and Judgment; its name intensifies the root for truth to mean the ultimate truth.

outline.heading: 'What is al-Haqqah?' Questions that engage
outline.gist: The Quranic question draws you into wondering, stimulating emotion and attachment beyond knowledge and ritual.

outline.heading: Like a marriage without love
outline.gist: Two good people with good values can still drift apart when affection is missing; faith without feeling fades the same way.

outline.heading: Thamud struck by a sudden blast
outline.gist: The surah begins its historical account with Thamud's swift, violent punishment.

outline.heading: Ad, Pharaoh and the ark of Nuh
outline.gist: Ad were battered for seven nights and eight days and left like hollow palm trunks; Pharaoh and the overturned towns were seized; believers were carried in the ark.

outline.heading: A reminder for a conscious ear
outline.gist: These stories need a listener aware enough to let them reach the soul and change behaviour.

outline.heading: Interlude
Hope and fear as motives
outline.gist: Love, desire, fear and reverence define human experience and make following Allah's word easier.

outline.heading: The Event: the heavens torn, eight bear the Throne, all exposed
outline.gist: The once-magnificent cosmos becomes frail, angels stand at its edges, and everything public and secret is laid bare.

outline.heading: Book in the right hand: 'come read my book'
outline.gist: The successful person wants to share his joy, showing forgiven sins and accepted deeds.

outline.heading: He prepared for this day: a pleasing life
outline.gist: He knew he would meet his account; now he lives calmly in a lofty garden and is told to enjoy what he worked for.

outline.heading: Book in the left hand: wishing he were never accountable
outline.gist: He wishes he had lived like an animal without responsibility; his wealth, connections and power are gone.

outline.heading: Seize him: unbelief and not urging food for the poor
outline.gist: After a graphic description of chains, the two reasons given are not believing in Allah and not encouraging the feeding of the needy.

outline.heading: The Quran never punishes for belief alone
outline.gist: Every punishment mentioned involves conduct toward others; Islam is beliefs plus a way of living with people and the earth.

outline.heading: Belief without action becomes harmful
outline.gist: Certainty without practice breeds arrogance; reading the Quran keeps the two joined.

outline.heading: Interlude
Paradise and punishment both need belief and behaviour
outline.gist: People like to disconnect creed from care for the world because it is easier, but the Quran does not support that narrative.

outline.heading: No friend, no food; an oath by what you see and do not see
outline.gist: Only the wrongdoers end there; Allah swears that this is the word of a noble messenger.

outline.heading: Not poetry, not sorcery: a reminder from the Lord of all
outline.gist: They reject it not from doubt but from not wanting to be reminded.

outline.heading: Had he fabricated a single word
outline.gist: Allah would have seized the Prophet and cut his aorta at once, and no one could stop it; he never did.

outline.heading: Reverence alongside understanding
outline.gist: The verse instils fear and respect, the feeling that this is serious and real, which must accompany comprehension.

outline.heading: Certain truth: glorify your Lord
outline.gist: Haqq al-yaqin is certainty so complete it becomes lived experience; the surah builds emotion so the final glorification comes from the heart.

outline.heading: Outro

takeaways: Cultivate emotional attachment to the deen, not just knowledge and good behaviour.
Let hope of mercy and fear of punishment motivate your obedience.
Encourage feeding the poor as part of your lifestyle, not just occasional charity.
Never separate belief from how you treat people and the world.
Read the Quran so its scenes of Judgment move your heart.

59:1.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
59:1.en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

59:2.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ لِأَوَّلِ ٱلۡحَشۡرِۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْۖ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمۡ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَمۡ يَحۡتَسِبُواْۖ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعۡبَۚ يُخۡرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَأَيۡدِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ فَٱعۡتَبِرُواْ يَٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
59:2.en: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah; but [the decree of] Allah came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision

59:3.ar: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ
59:3.en: And if not that Allah had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire

59:4.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ شَآقُّواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۖ وَمَن يُشَآقِّ ٱللَّهَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
59:4.en: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah - then indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

59:5.ar: مَا قَطَعۡتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوۡ تَرَكۡتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخۡزِيَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
59:5.en: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allah and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient

59:6.ar: وَمَآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَوۡجَفۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ خَيۡلࣲ وَلَا رِكَابࣲ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
59:6.en: And what Allah restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but Allah gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

59:7.ar: مَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ كَيۡ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةَۢ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَغۡنِيَآءِ مِنكُمۡۚ وَمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَىٰكُمۡ عَنۡهُ فَٱنتَهُواْۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
59:7.en: And what Allah restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allah and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

59:8.ar: لِلۡفُقَرَآءِ ٱلۡمُهَٰجِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُخۡرِجُواْ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ وَأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنࣰ ا وَيَنصُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
59:8.en: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allah and [His] approval and supporting Allah and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful

59:9.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو ٱلدَّارَ وَٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ يُحِبُّونَ مَنۡ هَاجَرَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِي صُدُورِهِمۡ حَاجَةࣰ مِّمَّآ أُوتُواْ وَيُؤۡثِرُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَلَوۡ كَانَ بِهِمۡ خَصَاصَةࣱۚ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
59:9.en: And [also for] those who were settled in al-Madinah and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what the emigrants were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful

59:10.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَلِإِخۡوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلࣰّ ا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمٌ
59:10.en: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful

59:11.ar: ۞أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُواْ يَقُولُونَ لِإِخۡوَٰنِهِمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَئِنۡ أُخۡرِجۡتُمۡ لَنَخۡرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمۡ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمۡ أَحَدًا أَبَدࣰ ا وَإِن قُوتِلۡتُمۡ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَشۡهَدُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
59:11.en: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers who have disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, "If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you." But Allah testifies that they are liars

59:12.ar: لَئِنۡ أُخۡرِجُواْ لَا يَخۡرُجُونَ مَعَهُمۡ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُواْ لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمۡ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمۡ لَيُوَلُّنَّ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
59:12.en: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be aided

59:13.ar: لَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ رَهۡبَةࣰ فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ لَّا يَفۡقَهُونَ
59:13.en: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allah. That is because they are a people who do not understand

59:14.ar: لَا يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمۡ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرࣰ ى مُّحَصَّنَةٍ أَوۡ مِن وَرَآءِ جُدُرِۭۚ بَأۡسُهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ شَدِيدࣱۚ تَحۡسَبُهُمۡ جَمِيعࣰ ا وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ شَتَّىٰۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ لَّا يَعۡقِلُونَ
59:14.en: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason

59:15.ar: كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ قَرِيبࣰ اۖ ذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
59:15.en: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment

59:16.ar: كَمَثَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ إِذۡ قَالَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ ٱكۡفُرۡ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءࣱ مِّنكَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
59:16.en: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds

59:17.ar: فَكَانَ عَٰقِبَتَهُمَآ أَنَّهُمَا فِي ٱلنَّارِ خَٰلِدَيۡنِ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
59:17.en: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrong-doers

59:18.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلۡتَنظُرۡ نَفۡسࣱ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ لِغَدࣲۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
59:18.en: O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do

59:19.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمۡ أَنفُسَهُمۡۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
59:19.en: And be not like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient

59:20.ar: لَا يَسۡتَوِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ
59:20.en: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success]

59:21.ar: لَوۡ أَنزَلۡنَا هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلࣲ لَّرَأَيۡتَهُۥ خَٰشِعࣰ ا مُّتَصَدِّعࣰ ا مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
59:21.en: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought

59:22.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
59:22.en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

59:23.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُ ٱلۡمُهَيۡمِنُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡجَبَّارُ ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
59:23.en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him

59:24.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُ ٱلۡبَارِئُ ٱلۡمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
59:24.en: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise
