if4wn2O8d2g.title: Surat Al-Hashr Summary
if4wn2O8d2g.one_line: Al-Hashr organizes Muslims' relations with groups: treaty-breakers, the poor, allies and dissenters, and builds wealth circulation into the system.
if4wn2O8d2g.summary: He places Al-Hashr in the Juz 28 cluster of Medinan surahs that organize the new, diverse society of Madinah. Where Al-Mujadilah dealt with individuals, Al-Hashr deals with groups. Banu an-Nadir had signed the constitution as citizens, then attempted to assassinate the Prophet and refused to make amends, so they were expelled without battle. The lesson he draws is citizenship: whoever lives in a society must abide by its agreed rules and change them through proper channels, not break them; this holds for Muslims living in Canada today. The verse on the palm trees cut during the siege shows the companions' respect for nature. The rules on fay', wealth gained without war, gave it to relatives, orphans, the poor and stranded travellers, so that wealth would not circulate only among the rich. An Islamic economy, he argues, must have upward mobility built into the system, not left to charity. The Ansar's selfless love for the emigrants shows that success lies in being saved from the greed of the self. The hypocrites' false promises to Banu an-Nadir show that dissenters who keep the covenant are tolerated, not expelled. The surah closes by calling for taqwa and long-term planning, and with a concentrated dose of spirituality in the Names of Allah.

outline.heading: Opening
The mufassal clusters and how they summarize the Quran
outline.gist: He names the remaining clusters and explains that they compress what the earlier parts of the Quran discussed at length.

outline.heading: Madinah's new pluralistic society
outline.gist: People of different lineages, ethnicities and faiths living under one constitution, and the Quran addressing its challenges.

outline.heading: From individuals to groups
outline.gist: Al-Mujadilah organized individual relations; Al-Hashr organizes how Muslims deal with groups that betray, ally, suffer or differ.

outline.heading: Banu an-Nadir's assassination attempt
outline.gist: Citizens under the constitution tried to kill the Prophet, refused to make amends, and were told to leave Madinah.

outline.heading: Abide by the agreed rules or leave
outline.gist: Whoever lives in a society must follow its rules and change them through proper channels, not break them.

outline.heading: Forts that did not protect
outline.gist: They expected their fortresses to protect them, but fear filled their hearts and they gave up quickly.

outline.heading: Exile instead of war
outline.gist: Had expulsion not been decreed, the alternative was war, which neither Allah nor the Muslims wanted.

outline.heading: Living by the laws of your country
outline.gist: Not liking the rules does not make breaking them acceptable; shared rules make societies prosper.

outline.heading: The palm trees cut during the siege
outline.gist: Cold companions cut palm branches for firewood and feared punishment; the Quran permitted it for need, showing their respect for nature.

outline.heading: Fay': wealth gained without war
outline.gist: Customarily such wealth went to soldiers and elders; the Quran gave it to Allah and His Messenger to distribute.

outline.heading: Fay' for relatives, orphans, the poor and travellers
outline.gist: The bounty is directed to those in society who cannot take care of themselves.

outline.heading: So wealth does not circulate only among the rich
outline.gist: A system rigged so the poor get poorer and the rich richer is un-Islamic.

outline.heading: Mobility built into the system; take what the Prophet gives
outline.gist: Upward movement must be designed in, not left to outside aid; the command to obey the Prophet backed a ruling people disliked.

outline.heading: Lifting the poor without impoverishing the rich
outline.gist: The goal was to raise the poor to the middle class, not to deprive the wealthy.

outline.heading: Interlude
The poor emigrants
outline.gist: The needy in society must be sought out and served, since they share the same path.

outline.heading: The Ansar's selfless love
outline.gist: They loved the emigrants and shared with them even when they themselves were in need.

outline.heading: Saved from the greed of the self
outline.gist: Success belongs to those protected from their own selfishness; helping the needy must become something we enjoy.

outline.heading: The hypocrites' false promises
outline.gist: They promised Banu an-Nadir to leave or fight with them, but Allah says they lie and fear the Muslims.

outline.heading: Dissenters who keep the covenant are not expelled
outline.gist: Only those who broke the constitution were removed; others who disagreed but kept the agreement stayed.

outline.heading: Interlude
Taqwa and long-term planning
outline.gist: Look to what you send ahead; relations with allies, traitors and the poor need plans for decades ahead.

outline.heading: Hearts harder than a mountain; the Names of Allah
outline.gist: Had the Quran descended on a mountain it would shake; the dynamic surah ends with a concentrated dose of spirituality.

themes.label: Community building, cooperation and the ummah
themes.note: The Medinan surahs organize a diverse society and Muslims' relations with other groups.

themes.label: Oaths, promises, trust and loyalty
themes.note: Banu an-Nadir broke the constitution they had signed and were expelled.

themes.label: Muslim identity and life in the West / Canada
themes.note: Muslims must abide by the agreed laws of the country they live in and change them through proper channels.

themes.label: Environment and stewardship of the earth
themes.note: The companions' reluctance to cut trees except out of need.

themes.label: Wealth, asceticism (zuhd), consumerism and money
themes.note: Fay' and the principle that wealth must not circulate only among the rich; upward mobility built into the economy.

themes.label: Obedience to Allah and the Messenger
themes.note: Take what the Prophet gives you, revealed to back an unpopular ruling.

themes.label: Selfishness, greed of the soul (shuhh) and selflessness
themes.note: The Ansar's selflessness and being saved from the greed of the self.

themes.label: Tolerance, pluralism and dealing with difference
themes.note: Hypocrites who kept the covenant were left in the society.

themes.label: Taqwa and God-consciousness
themes.note: Taqwa as long-term planning for what we meet Allah with.

themes.label: Spirituality, khushoo and the inner life
themes.note: The Names of Allah as a spiritual dose amid practical rulings.

maxims: Not liking the rules doesn't mean you can break them.
Wealth must not circulate only among the rich.
Uplift must be built into the system, not an exception.

stories.point: Breaking a shared covenant and refusing to make amends forfeits one's place in society.

stories.who: Companions cutting palm branches for warmth during the siege
stories.point: Their respect for nature made them fear sin over a small tree.
True brotherhood is selfless sharing even in one's own need.

contemporary: Muslims living under the laws of Canada and other countries
Economic systems in which the poor get poorer and the rich richer
takeaways: Abide by the laws of the country you live in and seek change through proper channels.
Respect nature and use resources only when needed.
Support economic arrangements that let the poor move up, not just charity.
Fight your own selfishness so helping others becomes a joy.
Plan long-term for the community's relations and for meeting Allah.

52:7.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur

52:8.en: Of it there is no preventer

52:9.en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

52:10.en: And the mountains will pass on, departing

52:11.en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers

52:12.en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves

52:13.ar: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
52:13.en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say]

52:14.ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
52:14.en: This is the Fire which you used to deny

52:15.ar: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
52:15.en: Then is this magic, or do you not see

52:16.ar: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
52:16.en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do

52:17.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure

52:18.ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
52:18.en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

52:19.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
52:19.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do

52:20.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
52:20.en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

52:21.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏
52:21.en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained

52:22.en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire

52:23.ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ‏
52:23.en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin

52:24.ar: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
52:24.en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected

52:25.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other

52:26.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
52:26.en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah]

52:27.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
52:27.en: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire

52:28.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
52:28.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful

52:29.ar: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
52:29.en: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman

52:30.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
52:30.en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time

52:31.ar: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
52:31.en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters

52:32.ar: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
52:32.en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people

52:33.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
52:33.en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe

52:34.ar: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
52:34.en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful

52:35.ar: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
52:35.en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]

52:36.ar: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
52:36.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain

52:37.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
52:37.en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]

52:38.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
52:38.en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority

52:39.en: Or has He daughters while you have sons

52:40.ar: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
52:40.en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down

52:41.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down

52:42.ar: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
52:42.en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan

52:43.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
52:43.en: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him

52:44.ar: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏
52:44.en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up

52:45.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
52:45.en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible

52:46.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
52:46.en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped

52:47.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
52:47.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know

52:48.ar: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
52:48.en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise

52:49.en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars

53:1.en: By the star when it descends

53:2.en: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred

53:3.en: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination

53:4.en: It is not but a revelation revealed

53:5.en: Taught to him by one intense in strength

53:6.en: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

53:7.en: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon

53:9.en: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer

53:10.en: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed

53:11.en: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw

53:12.en: So will you dispute with him over what he saw

53:13.en: And he certainly saw him in another descent

53:14.en: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary

53:15.en: Near it is the Garden of Refuge

53:16.en: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it]

53:17.en: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit]

53:18.ar: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
53:18.en: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord

53:19.en: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza

53:20.en: And Manat, the third - the other one

53:21.en: Is the male for you and for Him the female

53:22.en: That, then, is an unjust division

53:23.ar: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
53:23.en: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance

53:24.en: Or is there for man whatever he wishes

53:25.en: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]

53:26.ar: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
53:26.en: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves

53:27.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
53:27.en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names

53:28.ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
53:28.en: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all

53:29.ar: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
53:29.en: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life

53:30.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
53:30.en: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided

53:31.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
53:31.en: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward]

53:32.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةࣱ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
53:32.en: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him

53:33.en: Have you seen the one who turned away

53:34.en: And gave a little and [then] refrained

53:35.en: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees

53:36.ar: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
53:36.en: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

53:38.en: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

53:39.ar: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
53:39.en: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

53:40.en: And that his effort is going to be seen

53:41.en: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense

53:42.en: And that to your Lord is the finality

53:43.en: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

53:44.en: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

53:45.en: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female

53:46.en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

53:47.en: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation

53:48.en: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

53:49.en: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius

53:50.en: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad

53:51.en: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them]

53:52.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
53:52.en: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing

53:53.en: And the overturned towns He hurled down

53:54.en: And covered them by that which He covered

53:55.en: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt

53:56.en: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners

53:58.ar: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
53:58.en: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover

53:59.en: Then at this statement do you wonder

53:60.en: And you laugh and do not weep

53:62.en: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him]

rcyeKREsD9c.speaker: adnan
rcyeKREsD9c.speaker_note: his daily surah-summary series at MWN; refers back to his previous sessions in the cluster
rcyeKREsD9c.title: Surat At-Tur and An-Najm Summaries
rcyeKREsD9c.one_line: At-Tur contrasts guidance with stubborn disbelief; An-Najm contrasts certain, revealed knowledge with guesswork and ignorance.
rcyeKREsD9c.summary: Continuing the cluster of comparison surahs, he takes two surahs together. At-Tur sets guidance against disbelief. Its oaths place revelation inside the world we live in: the mountain where Musa received revelation, the written scripture, the House, the sky and the sea. It then warns those who play with the truth, shows the pious in Paradise, and promises that believing families who found guidance together will be joined at the level of their highest member. He dwells on the long run of questions beginning with 'or', which he calls one of the most structured theological arguments in the Quran: are they created from nothing, did they create themselves, can they produce something like it? Someone who refuses guidance will explain away even a falling sky. An-Najm sets knowledge against ignorance. The Prophet's night journey, his nearness to Allah and his vision at the Lote Tree are presented as witnessed knowledge, while idols, and the claim that angels are female, are names made up without evidence. His key lesson is that the biggest choice of your life cannot rest on probabilities; it needs certainty from a verified source, such as the scrolls of Ibrahim and Musa. He asks listeners to recite An-Najm, learn its story, and prostrate as the surah commands.

outline.heading: The cluster of comparison surahs
outline.gist: Each surah in the cluster compares two ways of living and points to their outcome, reward or punishment; he recaps Qaf and Adh-Dhariyat.

outline.heading: Oaths: Sinai, scripture, the House, sky and sea
outline.gist: Allah swears by the places and books of revelation, showing that guidance was sent within this world, and states that His punishment will surely come.

outline.heading: Woe to those who play with the truth
outline.gist: Disbelief is refusing what one knows is true; those absorbed in idle play are driven to the Fire on the Day of Judgment.

outline.heading: The pious in Paradise
outline.gist: A quick turn to the joy of the righteous in the gardens.

outline.heading: Families joined in Paradise; every soul pledged to its deeds
outline.gist: Believing families who found guidance together are raised to the level of their highest member without anyone losing reward, yet each person is held by his own deeds.

outline.heading: Interlude
You are neither soothsayer nor madman
outline.gist: Allah tells the Prophet to keep reminding, whatever names they call him.

outline.heading: The chain of 'or' questions
outline.gist: He describes the run of questions as a gold mine of theology: is he a poet, are they simply transgressors, did he invent it?

outline.heading: Produce something like it; created from nothing?
outline.gist: The challenge to produce a comparable book, and the questions of whether they came from nothing, created themselves or created the heavens and earth.

outline.heading: Those who will not be guided: the falling sky
outline.gist: Even seeing the sky fall they would call it heaped clouds; no sign moves one who refuses guidance, so leave them to their day.

outline.heading: Patience under Allah's watchful eye
outline.gist: 'You are in Our eyes' is an Arabic figure of speech for care, protection and love; glorify Allah morning and night.

outline.heading: The choice At-Tur offers
outline.gist: Be like those who deny every argument until they are shocked, or like the guided family joined in Paradise; either way, persevere.

outline.heading: An-Najm: knowledge versus ignorance
outline.gist: He introduces the second surah as a comparison between speaking from true knowledge and speaking from ignorance.

outline.heading: The night journey and the oath by the star
outline.gist: The surah opens with the Prophet's ascension; your companion has not strayed or erred.

outline.heading: He does not speak from desire
outline.gist: What the Prophet teaches is knowledge given to him by Allah, not his own invention.

outline.heading: As close as can be: two bow-lengths or nearer
outline.gist: An Arabic figure for the utmost nearness; whether he saw Allah is debated and not the point, the point is what he was taught.

outline.heading: The Lote Tree of the furthest boundary
outline.gist: He saw it again at a place no creation reached, where even Jibril did not go further, near the Garden of Refuge.

outline.heading: His sight did not swerve; idols are mere names
outline.gist: He saw the great signs of his Lord, while the idols are names they and their fathers made up with no authority.

outline.heading: Angels named as females: guesswork is not knowledge
outline.gist: Those who reject the Hereafter make up claims with no source, no chain and no evidence.

outline.heading: Certainty for the biggest choice; Allah knew you in the womb
outline.gist: The path you choose is a life-and-death decision that cannot rest on probability; do not claim purity, Allah knew you as a fetus.

outline.heading: A verified source: the scrolls of Ibrahim and Musa
outline.gist: Unlike the idolaters' made-up names, the revelation carries the knowledge of all earlier prophets.

outline.heading: No soul bears another's burden
outline.gist: You get only what you strove for; your efforts will be seen and fully repaid.

outline.heading: He makes laugh and weep, gives life and death
outline.gist: The surah lists Allah's power: creation, wealth, Lord of Sirius, destroyer of Ad, Thamud and the people of Nuh.

outline.heading: Which of your Lord's favours do you doubt?
outline.gist: Doubt comes from ignorance; the Quran even shares ancient words from the scrolls of Ibrahim.

outline.heading: The approaching Hour; laughing instead of weeping
outline.gist: The Hour has drawn near and nothing can hold it back; do you laugh and live aimlessly?

outline.heading: Prostrate to Allah and worship Him
outline.gist: The surah ends with a command to prostrate; he urges listeners to learn and recite An-Najm and see that none of it can be taken lightly.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.label: Guidance (hidayah)
themes.note: At-Tur compares guidance with disbelief; those who refuse guidance will explain away every sign.

themes.label: Seeking knowledge, learning and scholars
themes.note: An-Najm sets knowledge from a verified source against conjecture and made-up names.

themes.label: Eman: faith, certainty, doubt
themes.note: Righteousness needs certainty, not probability; doubt grows out of ignorance.

themes.label: Family: parents, relatives, kinship ties
themes.note: Families who sought guidance together are reunited in Paradise at the level of their highest member.

themes.label: Atheism, doubt and responding to disbelief
themes.note: The chain of questions in At-Tur as a structured argument against disbelief.

themes.label: The Prophet's attributes, character and example
themes.note: The Prophet as truthful witness of the ascension; he did not stray, err or invent.

themes.label: Accountability before Allah and goals
themes.note: Each soul gets only what it worked for and is judged on its own efforts.

themes.label: Patience (sabr) and perseverance
themes.note: The Prophet is told to persevere, knowing Allah watches over him.

themes.label: Salah: its meaning, etiquette and significance
themes.note: An-Najm closes with the command to prostrate.

maxims: You can't make life's biggest choice on probabilities.
Those who don't want guidance will not be guided.
Just because you don't understand it doesn't mean it didn't happen.

stories.who: The Prophet's night journey and ascension (Isra and Miraj)
stories.point: The Prophet speaks from what he witnessed and was taught, so his knowledge is certain.

takeaways: Seek guidance as a family so you can be joined together in Paradise.
Base your religious convictions on certain, verified sources rather than guesses.
Do not claim purity for yourself; Allah knows you better than you do.
Recite and study Surat An-Najm and perform its prostration.

60:1.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ تُلۡقُونَ إِلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدۡ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ يُخۡرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمۡ أَن تُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ رَبِّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ خَرَجۡتُمۡ جِهَٰدࣰ ا فِي سَبِيلِي وَٱبۡتِغَآءَ مَرۡضَاتِيۚ تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا۠ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَآ أَخۡفَيۡتُمۡ وَمَآ أَعۡلَنتُمۡۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡهُ مِنكُمۡ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
60:1.en: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allah, your Lord. If you have come out for jihad in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection, but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

60:2.ar: إِن يَثۡقَفُوكُمۡ يَكُونُواْ لَكُمۡ أَعۡدَآءࣰ وَيَبۡسُطُوٓاْ إِلَيۡكُمۡ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ وَأَلۡسِنَتَهُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّواْ لَوۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
60:2.en: If they gain dominance over you, they would be to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve

60:3.ar: لَن تَنفَعَكُمۡ أَرۡحَامُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡۚ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏
60:3.en: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

60:4.ar: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ لَكُمۡ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ فِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذۡ قَالُواْ لِقَوۡمِهِمۡ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُاْ مِنكُمۡ وَمِمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرۡنَا بِكُمۡ وَبَدَا بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلۡبَغۡضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَحۡدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوۡلَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسۡتَغۡفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءࣲۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
60:4.en: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone" except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allah. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination

60:5.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
60:5.en: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

60:6.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِيهِمۡ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
60:6.en: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

60:7.ar: ۞عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيۡتُم مِّنۡهُم مَّوَدَّةࣰۚ وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرࣱۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
60:7.en: Perhaps Allah will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allah is competent, and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

60:8.ar: لَّا يَنۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَلَمۡ يُخۡرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمۡ وَتُقۡسِطُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
60:8.en: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly

60:9.ar: إِنَّمَا يَنۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ قَٰتَلُوكُمۡ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَأَخۡرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَٰرِكُمۡ وَظَٰهَرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ إِخۡرَاجِكُمۡ أَن تَوَلَّوۡهُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
60:9.en: Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers

60:10.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا جَآءَكُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتُ مُهَٰجِرَٰتࣲ فَٱمۡتَحِنُوهُنَّۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِإِيمَٰنِهِنَّۖ فَإِنۡ عَلِمۡتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤۡمِنَٰتࣲ فَلَا تَرۡجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلࣱّ لَّهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مَّآ أَنفَقُواْۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَآ ءَاتَيۡتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّۚ وَلَا تُمۡسِكُواْ بِعِصَمِ ٱلۡكَوَافِرِ وَسۡـَٔلُواْ مَآ أَنفَقۡتُمۡ وَلۡيَسۡـَٔلُواْ مَآ أَنفَقُواْۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ حُكۡمُ ٱللَّهِ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡۖ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
60:10.en: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them. Allah is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give the disbelievers what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allah; He judges between you. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

60:11.ar: وَإِن فَاتَكُمۡ شَيۡءࣱ مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَـَٔاتُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتۡ أَزۡوَٰجُهُم مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنفَقُواْۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنُونَ
60:11.en: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allah, in whom you are believers

60:12.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتُ يُبَايِعۡنَكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّا يُشۡرِكۡنَ بِٱللَّهِ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يَسۡرِقۡنَ وَلَا يَزۡنِينَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلۡنَ أَوۡلَٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأۡتِينَ بِبُهۡتَٰنࣲ يَفۡتَرِينَهُۥ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِنَّ وَأَرۡجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعۡصِينَكَ فِي مَعۡرُوفࣲ فَبَايِعۡهُنَّ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُنَّ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
60:12.en: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allah, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

60:13.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ قَوۡمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَدۡ يَئِسُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡقُبُورِ
60:13.en: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the inhabitants of the graves

RFOaj6FMlSs.speaker: adnan
RFOaj6FMlSs.speaker_note: Surah Summaries series at his centre; same voice and method as the rest of the series
RFOaj6FMlSs.title: Surat Al-Mumtahanah Summary
RFOaj6FMlSs.one_line: Al-Mumtahanah sets how Muslims treat non-Muslims at war with them, those at peace, and those who join Islam: love is the default.
RFOaj6FMlSs.summary: He places al-Mumtahanah as the third surah of the cluster in the 28th juz that organizes Muslim life with others. The opening command not to show affection to those who are Allah's enemies and yours, he argues, only makes sense if love toward everyone is the Muslim default; the single exception is a group actively fighting Muslims, expelling them and trying to destroy their faith. Ibrahim had to break with his own father on these terms, and even then the believers pray not to become a cause of trial for their opponents. He dwells on the verse promising that Allah may yet place love between the believers and their enemies, noting it says love, not truce or tolerance. Verses 8 and 9 then state plainly that kindness and more-than-justice are owed to non-Muslims who neither fought nor expelled Muslims, and he criticizes extremists who dismiss these verses as abrogated. The rulings on women who emigrate show that a woman chooses her own faith, with dowries settled fairly in both directions. The pledge taken from new Muslims is a short social contract of core ethics. He asks the audience to read the verses themselves and live by them.

outline.heading: Opening
Al-Mumtahanah in the organizing cluster of the 28th juz
outline.gist: The cluster condenses earlier long surahs; this one organizes relations with non-Muslims at war, non-Muslims at peace, and people who switch over to Islam.

outline.heading: An enemy who expelled you: no secret alliance
outline.gist: The enemy here fought the Muslims and drove them from their homes; siding with them in secret is a mistake, and kinship will not protect you from their harm.

outline.heading: Why 'do not show them love' proves love is the default
outline.gist: Feelings are not addressed, only conduct; the wording only makes sense if Muslims normally show love to all people, with one hostile group excepted.

outline.heading: The example of Ibrahim and his father
outline.gist: Ibrahim and his followers stood apart from a people trying to force them out of their faith; he kept praying for his father until told to stop while the father persisted in hostility.

outline.heading: Do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve
outline.gist: The Companions had learned to love all and needed convincing; the prayer asks that there be no fighting that would bring punishment upon the other side.

outline.heading: Allah may place love between you and your enemies
outline.gist: The verse says love, not peace or tolerance; keep behaving rightly and defending yourself, and Allah is able to turn enmity into love and forgive the past.

outline.heading: How the Quran asks Muslims to see non-Muslims
outline.gist: Unless people declare war on Islam they receive love; even from those who do, love is only withheld while praying for the day it returns.

outline.heading: Interlude
Extremists who call these verses abrogated
outline.gist: Those on the extreme side of behaviour simply declare these explicit verses no longer in force.

outline.heading: Birr and more-than-justice for peaceful non-Muslims
outline.gist: Birr is the word used for treatment of parents, and qist means justice with tenderness, giving what is owed and more; Allah loves those who do this.

outline.heading: No alliance with those who fought and expelled you
outline.gist: Only alliance is forbidden, and only with those who declared war, expelled Muslims or helped others do so; allying with them makes you an oppressor too.

outline.heading: Interlude
Believing women who emigrate: verify, then do not return them
outline.gist: Be careful about spies, but once a woman's faith is established she is not sent back to people who would oppress her.

outline.heading: Repaying the dowry to the hostile husband
outline.gist: Even a husband from a hostile camp is repaid his dowry, because she has the right to go where she wants and believe what she wants.

outline.heading: A wife who leaves Islam: claim the dowry, not her
outline.gist: The same principle runs the other way: she may leave, and only the financial right is pursued, which shows women's freedom of choice in religion.

outline.heading: The pledge of new Muslims and the closing verse
outline.gist: Newcomers agree to six points of basic ethics; the last verse repeats the ban on allying with those who show hostility.

outline.heading: Women's status recurs across this cluster
outline.gist: Organizing Muslim life requires addressing women's rights, which appear in nearly every surah of the cluster starting with al-Mujadilah.

outline.heading: The pledge as a minimum social contract
outline.gist: No shirk, no killing, stealing, zina or social sins, and support for whatever good the society promotes; rituals come later between them and Allah, but living together needs shared ethics.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.label: Tolerance, pluralism and dealing with difference
themes.note: Love toward all people is the Muslim default; only an actively hostile group is excepted, and even then Muslims pray for love to return.

themes.label: Tolerance, pluralism and dealing with difference
themes.note: Verses 8 and 9 explicitly command birr and more-than-justice toward peaceful non-Muslims and forbid only alliance with aggressors.

themes.label: Extremism, bad religiosity and distorted practice
themes.note: Extremist behaviour rests on declaring these clear verses abrogated, which he rejects.

themes.label: Justice and refusing oppression
themes.note: Allying with oppressors makes you one of them; qist is justice plus kindness.

themes.label: Gender relations, chastity and modesty
themes.note: The emigrant women verses establish a woman's right to choose her faith and settle dowries fairly; women's status runs through the cluster.

themes.label: Stories of earlier prophets
themes.note: Ibrahim's break with his father shows the limit case of hostility over faith.

themes.label: Community building, cooperation and the ummah
themes.note: The pledge sets the shared ethical minimum people need to live together and support good initiatives in society.

maxims: The default for Muslims is to show love to everybody
Not peace, not a truce: the word was love

stories.point: Even a prophet had to stand apart from family who tried to coerce him out of his faith, while continuing to pray for him as long as he could.

takeaways: Treat non-Muslims who are not at war with Islam with kindness that goes beyond strict justice.
Withhold alliance only from those actively fighting or oppressing Muslims, and still pray that love replaces enmity.
Read verses 60:8-9 yourself rather than accepting claims that they are abrogated.
Respect a person's freedom to choose their faith and settle financial rights fairly.
Support the good initiatives of the society you live in.

29:2.ar: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتۡرَكُوٓاْ أَن يَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمۡ لَا يُفۡتَنُونَ
29:2.en: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried

29:3.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ فَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
29:3.en: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars

29:4.ar: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسۡبِقُونَاۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
29:4.en: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge

29:5.ar: مَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَأٓتࣲۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
29:5.en: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing

29:6.ar: وَمَن جَٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَٰهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
29:6.en: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds

29:7.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
29:7.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do

29:8.ar: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حُسۡنࣰ اۖ وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشۡرِكَ بِي مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمࣱ فَلَا تُطِعۡهُمَآۚ إِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
29:8.en: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do

29:9.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
29:9.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise]

29:10.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِيَ فِي ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتۡنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِۖ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصۡرࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمۡۚ أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
29:10.en: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures

29:11.ar: وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ
29:11.en: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites

29:12.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبِعُواْ سَبِيلَنَا وَلۡنَحۡمِلۡ خَطَٰيَٰكُمۡ وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنۡ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
29:12.en: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars

29:13.ar: وَلَيَحۡمِلُنَّ أَثۡقَالَهُمۡ وَأَثۡقَالࣰ ا مَّعَ أَثۡقَالِهِمۡۖ وَلَيُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ
29:13.en: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent

29:14.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمۡ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمۡسِينَ عَامࣰ ا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
29:14.en: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers

29:15.ar: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
29:15.en: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds

29:16.ar: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُۖ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
29:16.en: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allah and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know

29:17.ar: إِنَّمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡثَٰنࣰ ا وَتَخۡلُقُونَ إِفۡكًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لَكُمۡ رِزۡقࣰ ا فَٱبۡتَغُواْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزۡقَ وَٱعۡبُدُوهُ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لَهُۥٓۖ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
29:17.en: You only worship, besides Allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allah provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned

29:18.ar: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُواْ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أُمَمࣱ مِّن قَبۡلِكُمۡۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
29:18.en: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification

29:19.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ يُبۡدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرࣱ‏
29:19.en: Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allah, is easy

29:20.ar: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ بَدَأَ ٱلۡخَلۡقَۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
29:20.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allah will produce the final creation. Indeed Allah, over all things, is competent

29:21.ar: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُقۡلَبُونَ
29:21.en: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned

29:22.ar: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيࣲّ وَلَا نَصِيرࣲ‏
29:22.en: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper

29:23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَتِي وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
29:23.en: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment

29:24.ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوهُ أَوۡ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
29:24.en: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

29:25.ar: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذۡتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡثَٰنࣰ ا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيۡنِكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَكۡفُرُ بَعۡضُكُم بِبَعۡضࣲ وَيَلۡعَنُ بَعۡضُكُم بَعۡضࣰ ا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
29:25.en: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allah, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers

29:26.ar: ۞فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطࣱۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّي مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
29:26.en: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

29:27.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَجۡرَهُۥ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
29:27.en: And We gave to Him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous

29:28.ar: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنۡ أَحَدࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
29:28.en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds

29:29.ar: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقۡطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأۡتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ ٱلۡمُنكَرَۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
29:29.en: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allah, if you should be of the truthful

29:30.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي عَلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
29:30.en: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people

29:31.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُهۡلِكُوٓاْ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِۖ إِنَّ أَهۡلَهَا كَانُواْ ظَٰلِمِينَ
29:31.en: And when Our messengers came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that Lot's city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers

29:32.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطࣰ اۚ قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَاۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
29:32.en: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind

29:33.ar: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوطࣰ ا سِيٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعࣰ اۖ وَقَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَكَ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
29:33.en: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind

29:34.ar: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ رِجۡزࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَفۡسُقُونَ
29:34.en: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient

29:35.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَآ ءَايَةَۢ بَيِّنَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَعۡقِلُونَ
29:35.en: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason

29:36.ar: وَإِلَىٰ مَدۡيَنَ أَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبࣰ ا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرۡجُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
29:36.en: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

29:37.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلرَّجۡفَةُ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ فِي دَارِهِمۡ جَٰثِمِينَ
29:37.en: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone

29:38.ar: وَعَادࣰ ا وَثَمُودَاْ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمۡۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُواْ مُسۡتَبۡصِرِينَ
29:38.en: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception

29:39.ar: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانُواْ سَٰبِقِينَ
29:39.en: And [We destroyed] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]

29:40.ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذۡنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ حَاصِبࣰ ا وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَخَذَتۡهُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ خَسَفۡنَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ أَغۡرَقۡنَاۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
29:40.en: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves

29:41.ar: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتۡ بَيۡتࣰ اۖ وَإِنَّ أَوۡهَنَ ٱلۡبُيُوتِ لَبَيۡتُ ٱلۡعَنكَبُوتِۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
29:41.en: The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew

29:42.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَيۡءࣲۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
29:42.en: Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

29:43.ar: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِۖ وَمَا يَعۡقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡعَٰلِمُونَ
29:43.en: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge

29:44.ar: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
29:44.en: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers

29:45.ar: ٱتۡلُ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِۗ وَلَذِكۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَصۡنَعُونَ
29:45.en: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do

29:46.ar: ۞وَلَا تُجَٰدِلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَقُولُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَٰحِدࣱ وَنَحۡنُ لَهُۥ مُسۡلِمُونَ
29:46.en: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him

29:47.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦۖ وَمِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
29:47.en: And thus We have sent down to you the Qur'an. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers

29:48.ar: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتۡلُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبࣲ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَۖ إِذࣰ ا لَّٱرۡتَابَ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
29:48.en: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Otherwise the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt

29:49.ar: بَلۡ هُوَ ءَايَٰتُۢ بَيِّنَٰتࣱ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَۚ وَمَا يَجۡحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
29:49.en: Rather, the Qur'an is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers

29:50.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡأٓيَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
29:50.en: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner

29:51.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِهِمۡ أَنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحۡمَةࣰ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِقَوۡمࣲ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
29:51.en: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe

29:52.ar: قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ شَهِيدࣰ اۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُواْ بِٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
29:52.en: Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers

29:53.ar: وَيَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَلَوۡلَآ أَجَلࣱ مُّسَمࣰّ ى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ وَلَيَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بَغۡتَةࣰ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
29:53.en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not

29:54.ar: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
29:54.en: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers

29:55.ar: يَوۡمَ يَغۡشَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَمِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِهِمۡ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
29:55.en: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do

29:56.ar: يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ أَرۡضِي وَٰسِعَةࣱ فَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
29:56.en: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me

29:57.ar: كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ
29:57.en: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned

29:58.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ غُرَفࣰ ا تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ نِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
29:58.en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

29:59.en: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely

29:60.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةࣲ لَّا تَحۡمِلُ رِزۡقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
29:60.en: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing

29:61.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
29:61.en: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allah." Then how are they deluded

29:64.ar: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا لَهۡوࣱ وَلَعِبࣱۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ لَهِيَ ٱلۡحَيَوَانُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
29:64.en: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew

29:65.ar: فَإِذَا رَكِبُواْ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ دَعَوُاْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡبَرِّ إِذَا هُمۡ يُشۡرِكُونَ
29:65.en: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him

29:66.ar: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُواْۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
29:66.en: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know

29:67.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنࣰ ا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنۡ حَوۡلِهِمۡۚ أَفَبِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُونَ وَبِنِعۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكۡفُرُونَ
29:67.en: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve

29:68.ar: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ كَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوࣰ ى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
29:68.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers

29:69.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
29:69.en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good

22:39.ar: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ظُلِمُواْۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصۡرِهِمۡ لَقَدِيرٌ
22:39.en: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory

2:216.ar: كُتِبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرۡهࣱ لَّكُمۡۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكۡرَهُواْ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَهُوَ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّواْ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَهُوَ شَرࣱّ لَّكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
2:216.en: Fighting has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allah Knows, while you know not

8:25.ar: وَٱتَّقُواْ فِتۡنَةࣰ لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنكُمۡ خَآصَّةࣰۖ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
8:25.en: And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allah is severe in penalty
